title: Sal Pais applauds Rossi's panel example

tellings.quote: panel one time with Sal Pais and a handful of others last two summers ago and basically I used this exact example and Sal Pais started basically clapping

plain: Dave Rossi, a guest who talks about advanced physics, says that about two summers before the interview, around 2023, he sat on a panel with an inventor named Salvatore Pais and a handful of others. He says he used the very example he had just given Michels, and that Pais started clapping. Rossi tells it as a sign that someone in that field took his idea seriously.
